title: LabResult (us-ga-hemp profile)
description: GA-COA-GATE structural subset (40-32-5-.06; O.C.G.A. § 2-23-9.1 'within the last 12 months'; GDA https://agr.georgia.gov/hemp-retail-consumable-hemp-licenses retrieved 2026-09-02; decision-coa-publication-gate): a publishable GA Package's linked LabResult must report the full analyte panel, pass overall and on contaminants, and carry a public URL and a test date. allOf-only over core/lab-result.schema.json. The '≤12 months old' recency check is date-relative (today vs tested_at) and cannot be expressed as a static JSON Schema constraint — it lives in rules/index.mjs#checkCoaGate, keyed to the same GA-COA-GATE rule ID. 365 days is fail-closed encoding of statutory 12 months.

tested_at.description: GA-COA-GATE — required (redundant type restatement so ajv strict mode's required/properties check passes; the constraint itself is already core's). The ≤12-month recency check is in rules/index.mjs#checkCoaGate.

public_url.description: GA-COA-GATE — publicly reachable COA target, distinct from any internal attachment.

contaminants_passed.description: GA-COA-GATE — pesticides/heavy metals/residual solvents/microbials panel must pass.

cannabinoids.description: GA-COA-GATE — full analyte panel (research-synthesis P6): Δ9-THC, CBD, CBDA, CBG, CBGA, CBN, HHC each present at least once.
